scope: CPU-only comparisons on fixed conditional M62/F source cohorts. Every policy owns the same original source families; native endpoint/case/iteration counts and hashes can differ across A/B. accounting: One pinned timing thread includes reusable suffix expansion, mod9/OEE and optional shared B screening, scalar verification and all flagged wide rechecks. Sampling, table/array setup, independent validation and JSON output are excluded. Different F classes are conditional strata, not equal population shares.

config.comparison_scope: Same original source families for every A/B; native endpoint counts, cases, iterations and checksums may differ across A/B. No GPU savings or full-range estimate is inferred here.
config.digest_note: FNV-1a over ordered 16-byte little-endian source n0 values; deterministic identity, not cryptographic.
config.sampling: Uniform conditional baseline M62/F draws, rejecting improved13 ancestry culls at or before K50; duplicates retained. No K38 walkback filtering. These are conditional endpoint cohorts, not full-range K38 packages.
config.timing_scope: Fused reusable suffix expansion, mod9/OEE, optional resident B arrays, scalar tails and flagged wide rechecks; setup, sampling, validation and JSON excluded.
